speaker: Sean Douglas
role: Second Counselor in the Presiding Bishopric
title: The Hour of Your Mission Is Come
summary: Bishop Douglas teaches that missionaries are set apart and commissioned by the Savior, that the rising generation was held in reserve for this time, and that a mission is worth putting everything else in the back seat for a season. His main story is Elder Merlin Sanchez of the Lima Peru mission, baptized near 24, who came back to church, served, married, and became a bishop and then a stake president. He invites young men and women, especially young converts, to put a full-time mission high on their list and to read the Lord's call to Thomas B. Marsh with their own names in it.
